text:
QUOTE: Without a callback, unlisted tools are denied. With one, every call passes approval. Deny-list entries still block at `execute`, but only after the callback has already reported the call.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says that with a callback every unlisted call passes, and that without one it is denied. It never concludes that the effective posture is default-allow at the blocking gate for tools matching neither list.
